abstract: Induction of differentiation as a treatment modality for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGCTs) may promote the development of residual mature teratoma (RMT), which is usually associated with primary tumors that are capable of spontaneous somatic differentiation. Therefore, we studied the combination of a cytotoxic drug and a differentiation-inducing agent in vivo in three murine teratocarcinoma models with different levels of spontaneous somatic differentiation: E86-379 (moderate differentiation); NF-1 (poor differentiation); and MH-15 (no differentiation). We used retinoic acid (RA) as differentiation-inducing agent and cisdiaminodichloroplatinum (CDDP) as cytotoxic drug, plus a combination of both. In four separate experiments, the combination of RA and CDDP gave a significant further reduction of tumor size as compared with treatment with either RA or CDDP alone. Morphologically intact tumor after treatment with combined RA-CDDP contained a smaller proportion of undifferentiated tissue (embryonal carcinoma) than after CDDP alone. However, somatic differentiation was not induced in the tumor model lacking spontaneous somatic differentiation. Toxicity was reflected in loss of body weight and death of some animals and closely paralleled the degree of tumor reduction in all experiments.
abstract_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT)に対する治療法として分化誘導を行うと、残存成熟奇形腫(RMT)の発生を促す可能性があり、これは自然に体細胞分化能を持つ原発腫瘍と関連している。そこで、自然発生の体細胞分化の程度が異なる3種のマウス奇形癌モデル、すなわちE86-379(中等度の分化)、NF-1(低分化)、MH-15(分化なし)において、細胞傷害性薬剤と分化誘導薬の併用を生体内で検討した。分化誘導薬としてレチノイン酸(RA)、細胞傷害性薬剤としてシスジアミンジクロロ白金(CDDP)を用い、両者の併用も行った。4回の独立した実験において、RAとCDDPの併用は、RAまたはCDDP単独治療と比べて腫瘍サイズをさらに有意に縮小させた。併用療法後も形態的に残存した腫瘍は、CDDP単独後と比べて未分化組織(胎児性癌)の割合が小さかった。しかし、自然発生の体細胞分化を欠く腫瘍モデルでは体細胞分化は誘導されなかった。毒性は体重減少と一部の動物の死亡として現れ、すべての実験で腫瘍縮小の程度とほぼ平行していた。
